evals.prompt: My map misses the routes declared in routes.yml files, in two forms: a path with a controller, and a path with a form. Write the rules for this shape.
evals.expected_output: One small rule per case, two rules in all, added to the project's own rutter and run with periplus map. Never one combined rule.
expectations: Writes one small rule for each of the two cases
Does not write one combined rule for both cases
Runs periplus map and shows the new nodes or edges

evals.prompt: The stack I want to map has no bundled rutter. Start one.
evals.expected_output: A new rutter in the project's .periplus/packs, with its first small rule run against real files.
expectations: Creates the rutter under .periplus/packs in the project
Keeps stack knowledge in the rutter and asks for no engine change
Names no real project in the rutter's rules, examples or prose

evals.prompt: I think a rutter cannot express this call shape, so the engine needs changing. Can you confirm?
evals.expected_output: The answer writes the rule and runs it first, and only calls the gap the engine's when the engine refuses the rule, quoting its message.
expectations: Writes the rule and runs it before answering
Quotes the engine's message if it refuses the rule
Does not claim the rutter cannot without that failed probe
